verdict.rationale: Mesh documents a broad API. It covers customer creation and screening (sync, async and batch), monitoring configuration, case and alert review and remediation, exports, case audit trails, IAM roles and transaction processing, backed by a published OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema. The docs explicitly say cases, alerts and risks can be handled via the web app or the API. However, no parity claim exists, and some functions appear UI-only: API credentials and their permissions are generated in the web application, and screening configurations and risk-score equation setup are not shown as API operations. missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, API endpoints for credential/permission management, API endpoints for screening configuration and risk-score equation setup, independent hands-on confirmation of coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated either via the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application or by integrating with the API for use in your own case management system.
The schema documents customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources.
This endpoint allows you to set the monitoring configuration for a single customer.
Create a new export by selecting an export type and a start and end date.
Returns the audit log trail for a case.
Creates a transaction and executes our payment screening and transaction monitoring processes.
